hypothesis.statement: The two-stage merge spelling is necessary but not sufficient: it decides WHICH value the return web coalesces with only when the two exits live in different registers to begin with. Here both `best` and `value` are loop-carried in the same scan, so force them apart -- give the helper a third, dead argument or make `value` a fresh load inside the helper (pass the record pointer, not the loaded halfword) so the loaded value is not already sitting in the caller's r0 when the inline is expanded.
